role: C04 small Material individual contextual source review
decision: The upstream modern paginator replaces its page-size label counter with private CDK _IdGenerator. The owned and Material 16 legacy templates display a page-size label and independently bind the select aria-label to the same intl text; neither template associates the label by an ID. The 16 legacy class extends the historical shared base, whereas the ID field belongs to the separate modern MatPaginator class, not that base; the owned class extends its own base. Do not transplant the modern private generator into the owned component. Multiple instances, accessible names and supported hydration behavior remain open runtime questions; this source decision does not establish equivalence.

review_context.owned_boundary: Owned legacy public API exports its component and owned base. Tagged legacy public API exports legacy component and aliases the shared paginator base; tagged paginator source places _pageSizeLabelId in the separate modern MatPaginator, not the base.
